newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian government sells property services.
newsitem.headline: Australian government sells property services.

text.p: The Australian government said on Friday it had chosen Knight Frank Price Waterhouse Property Management Pty Ltd as preferred buyer for its property consulting business, the Australian Property Group.

The successful bidder, a joint venture between Price Waterhouse and Knight Frank Australia, had extensive experience in providing services to government bodies, Finance Minister John Fahey and Administrative Services Minister David Jull said in a joint statement.

The sale is the latest in a series of sales of business units from Jull's department announced in the 1997/98 budget unveiled on May 13. No price was given in Friday's announcement and no projections were made in the budget papers.
The Australian Property Group, which has offices around the country, provides property management, real estate services, consultancy services and portfolio management.
